definitions.explanation: A horizontal scroll with illustrations, often telling a story. A major art form in classical Japan, combining painting with narrative text. Short for {絵巻|えまき}{物|もの}.

examples.japanese: {絵巻|えまき}を{広|ひろ}げて{鑑賞|かんしょう}する。
examples.english: Unroll and appreciate a picture scroll.

examples.japanese: この{絵巻|えまき}は{平安|へいあん}{時代|じだい}に{描|えが}かれたものだ。
examples.english: This picture scroll was painted during the Heian period.

examples.japanese: {国宝|こくほう}に{指定|してい}されている{絵巻|えまき}{物|もの}が{特別|とくべつ}{展示|てんじ}され、{全国|ぜんこく}から{多|おお}くの{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}が{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: A picture scroll designated as a National Treasure was put on special display, and many visitors came from all over the country.

notes:
USAGE NOTE:
{絵巻|えまき} is the short form of {絵巻|えまき}{物|もの} (emakimono). These horizontal scrolls are read by unrolling them from right to left, revealing the narrative scene by scene. Famous examples include the {源氏|げんじ}{物語|ものがたり}{絵巻|えまき} (Tale of Genji picture scroll) and the {鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}{戯画|ぎが} (Scrolls of Frolicking Animals).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絵巻|えまき}{物|もの} (picture scroll — full form)
- {絵巻|えまき}を{広|ひろ}げる (unroll a picture scroll)
- {物語|ものがたり}{絵巻|えまき} (narrative picture scroll)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {掛|か}け{軸|じく}: hanging scroll (vertical, for display)
- {巻物|まきもの}: scroll (general term, can be text-only)
